title: Electric field magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be correctly expressed as E = 3mg/(4q).

title: Tension magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be correctly expressed as T = 5mg/4.

title: Force equilibrium setup
description: Important: The solution must resolve forces horizontally and vertically for the static equilibrium, applying F_electric = qE and F_gravity = mg.

title: Net force after cut
description: Important: For part (3), the student must correctly identify the net force as the vector sum of gravity and the electric force, giving magnitude 5mg/4 and direction 37° below horizontal (or equivalent).

title: Velocity after cut
description: Important: For part (4), the student must apply kinematics (v=at) with the correct constant acceleration from part (3), yielding v = 1.25gt in the same direction as the net force.

title: Direction specification
description: Optional: Clear description or diagram showing the angle (37°) relative to the vertical or horizontal for the net force and velocity directions.

title: Incorrect angle or trig
description: Pitfall: Using sine/cosine incorrectly (e.g., swapping 0.6 and 0.8) or misidentifying the angle in the force triangle.

title: Sign or vector error
description: Pitfall: Treating forces as scalars, missing that the net force after the cut is constant and not along the string's original direction.
